title: 04. My Tummy Hurts. I Want to Go Home.
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Kongi was excited to be in the Rainbow Class. There were favorite picture books, and lunch would be delicious. But since morning, Kongi's tummy had been rumbling. Something felt a little strange.
As time passed, the tummy began to ache more and more. Kongi tried going to the bathroom, but nothing came out. Rubbing that sore tummy, Kongi lowered their head. What's wrong with me?
Lunch was finally here, with Kongi's favorite food! But with a sore tummy, Kongi didn't want any of it and only fiddled with a spoon. My tummy hurts. I want to go home.

After lunch came playtime. The friends zoomed down the slide. Kongi loved the slide, too, but the sore tummy made it impossible to play. Kongi sat watching from a corner. My tummy hurts. I want to go home.

Hori brought Kongi a favorite picture book. Kongi, want to read this together? But the tummy ache made even a fun story hard to enjoy. Kongi shook their head weakly. My tummy hurts. I want to go home.
Nothing fun felt fun anymore, and Kongi felt sad inside, too. The tummy still ached, and tears filled Kongi's eyes. Kongi buried their face against both knees.
Gentle Teacher Sheep sat beside Kongi. Where does it hurt? If your tummy hurts, you can tell me. A warm hand rubbed Kongi's tummy gently. Kongi nodded. Teacher, I need to go to the bathroom.
They went to the bathroom together. Kongi gave a little push, and at last, out it came! What had been making that tummy sore was finally gone. Oh! My tummy doesn't hurt anymore! Kongi's face lit up.

After washing hands carefully, Kongi returned to the classroom, feeling completely different. Friends, let me play, too! The slide was fun again, and so were the picture books. Kongi bounced happily around.

At pick-up time, Kongi bowed to Teacher Sheep. Thank you, Teacher! When your tummy hurts, it's best to tell someone instead of keeping it to yourself. Then you can get help and feel ready to play again.
